statement: 镜头权威使用确定性的 240 帧短滚动商业产品镜头状态：以拉远长焦感、稳定中心、足够留白和阶段性构图服务完全爆炸首帧、合体、球体核心、剖面和清水流；不得用过近镜头、可见灯具或大幅透视压迫破坏工业摄影质感。

timeline_state.scroll_story_length: short hero scroll around one and a half viewports

camera_phase_policy.composition: wide enough to read all major separated valve parts, including body halves, upper and lower assemblies and spring/hardware layers
stable centered three-quarter view; inward part motion remains legible without camera chasing every small component
the polished ball remains the visual anchor while surrounding parts do not dominate its reflection
camera holds enough distance for the cutaway to read as product truth rather than a repair diagram
final hold keeps valve identity, cutaway and clean flow readable within homepage hero framing

forbidden: product center drift that breaks hero readability
close lens perspective that makes studio gear feel near the product
cropping away exploded parts that are required for the opening read
camera motion that competes with assembly motion
